Verifies offline emulation with socket-layer network throttling.
Offline:
fetch(): Failed to fetch
Error: net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED
Offline while throttled:
fetch() of a cacheable resource: throttled
fetch() of the cached resource: 200
fetch() of another resource: Failed to fetch
Back online:
fetch() of the cached resource: not throttled
fetch() of another resource: throttled
An offline rule with a URL pattern:
fetch() of a matching resource: Failed to fetch
fetch() of another resource: throttled
